messages:
Talia: hi everyone — im Talia (she/they), joined today on product analytics. remote-first, but popping into the SF office next wed. excited to be here! :tada:
Talia: quick personal facts: big fan of cold brew, guilty karaoke enthusiast, and have a very opinionated houseplant named 'Chairman Meow' (yes it's a cat).
Jun: welcome Talia!! :wave: SF meetup next wed — we have a tiny karaoke corner in the lounge. also there's a legendary cold-brew stash in the fridge.
Priya: hi Talia, welcome :heart: if youre in Tues-Fri we usually do a burrito run at 12:30. my vote for plant name: "Fernie Heart"
Marco: welcome! coffee + karaoke is a strong combo. also our office ramen spot is two blocks over: "Shio & Co." — slurp recommendation.
Talia: oooh ramen rec noted. shout if anyone wants to meet for lunch next wed.
HR-bot: Hi Talia :wave: Badge is with reception. Please check your onboarding tasks in the portal and confirm your emergency contact. First-week team lunch scheduled for Thursday 12:30.
DevEx-bot: @Talia — IT ticket created for laptop + Slack groups. Run `setup.sh` after you get your laptop to auto-join the dev VPN.
Talia: thanks! @Priya @Jun im down for burrito run if you want company on Wed.
Priya: yes please, count me in.
Jun: me too.
Marco: maybe — ping me later in the day and ill confirm.
Talia: small poll: who's into a rooftop picnic on Friday? :sun_with_face:
Jun: yes!
Priya: yes!!
Marco: depends on weather
HR-bot: Reminder: rooftop events require rooftop-waiver signed in the HR portal.
Talia: done and done. also curious where the best desk to claim for natural light is — any recs?
Jun: 2C by the windows is sunny but cold in the morning. 4A has good light + outlet access.
Priya: 4A for the chargers, 2C if you like plants.
Talia: gonna aim for 4A then. also: mug preference poll  ceramic vs insulated?
Marco: insulated for long meetings.
Priya: ceramic all the way.
Jun: insulated when travel, ceramic in office.
Talia: ceramic it is — fox mug lives on. thanks team, see you around! :fox_face:
DevEx-bot: Onboarding checklist: badge collected , laptop assigned , Slack groups joined .
HR-bot: Welcome again, Talia! :sparkles:
